hook.text: Bloated after every meal? It's not the food. It's HOW you're eating.
queries: person hand on stomach bloated discomfort
woman pressing belly looking down kitchen

tips.text: First, slow down. Most people swallow air when eating fast. Chew each bite twenty times. This breaks down food and stops air from entering your stomach.
queries: person chewing food slowly mindfully closeup
woman eating salad fork mouth slow motion
person taking small bite calm meal

tips.text: Second, drink warm water before meals. Cold water shocks your digestion. Warm water activates your stomach acid and breaks down food faster.
queries: warm water glass steam rising morning
person sipping warm water peaceful kitchen
kettle pouring hot water mug closeup
lemon water warm cup hands holding

tips.text: Third, try peppermint tea after meals. Peppermint relaxes your digestive muscles and helps trapped gas release. Most people feel relief in twenty minutes.
